# API Documentation & Machine Interfaces (LLMS.txt)

> Developer endpoints, protocols, schemas, and programmatic access for NICHSEDGE.

## Protocols & Catalogs
- **ARD Discovery**: `https://nichsedge.github.io/.well-known/ard.json`
- **A2A Agent Card**: `https://nichsedge.github.io/.well-known/agent-card.json`
- **Agent Skills**: `https://nichsedge.github.io/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`
- **RFC 9727 API Catalog**: `https://nichsedge.github.io/.well-known/api-catalog`
- **MCP Server Card**: `https://nichsedge.github.io/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Spec**: `https://nichsedge.github.io/openapi.json`
- **Auth Specification**: `https://nichsedge.github.io/auth.md`

## REST Endpoints (v1)
- `GET /api/v1/profile`: Returns full profile, current roles, and contact info.
- `GET /api/v1/projects`: Returns list of engineering and data projects.
- `GET /api/v1/skills`: Returns categorized technical skills and proficiencies.
- `GET /api/v1/ask`: NLWeb question-answering endpoint.
- `POST /api/v1/ask`: NLWeb JSON payload question-answering endpoint.
